context: A dad teaches his young son about food and farming basics
purpose: Teach: 温暖/少子化/農地/国産/繊維/途上/にわたる/付加

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、どうしてスーパーには外国の野菜がいっぱいあるの?
lines.en: Dad, why are there so many foreign vegetables at the supermarket?
lines.style: Curious child asking a simple, wide-eyed question.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いい質問だね。日本の農地がどんどん減っているからだよ。
lines.en: Good question. It's because Japan's farmland keeps shrinking.
lines.style: Warm fatherly tone, gentle and patient with explanation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へえ、農地が減るとどうなるの?
lines.en: Huh, what happens when farmland decreases?
lines.style: Innocent follow-up question from a young child.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 国産の野菜が少なくなるんだ。少子化で農家を継ぐ若い人も減っていてね。
lines.en: Domestic vegetables become scarce. With the declining birthrate, fewer young people inherit farms too.
lines.style: Educational dad voice, simplifying adult topics for a child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 若い農家さんがいないと、お米とかも作れないの?
lines.en: If there are no young farmers, can't we make rice either?
lines.style: Worried child voice, slowly grasping the implications.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうだね。それに地球温暖化で天気もおかしくて、農業はますます大変なんだよ。
lines.en: Right. And with global warming making weather strange, farming gets harder and harder.
lines.style: Calm dad tone, adding another layer to the lesson.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 服も食べ物みたいに外国から来るの?
lines.en: Do clothes come from foreign countries like food does?
lines.style: Curious child connecting dots between different topics.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、服の繊維の多くは途上国から来てるんだ。長年にわたる貿易の歴史があるんだよ。
lines.en: Yes, most clothing fibers come from developing countries. There's a long history of trade spanning many years.
lines.style: Patient teaching voice, weaving in geography and history naturally.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあ日本は何を売ってるの?
lines.style: Eager child voice, wanting to complete the picture.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 日本は付加価値の高いものを作って売るのが得意なんだ。技術がすごいんだよ。
lines.en: Japan is good at making and selling high value-added products. Our technology is amazing.
lines.style: Proud fatherly tone wrapping up the lesson with national pride.
